home.title: Grading
home.lead: Get your cards graded by PSA, CGC or BGS. Hand them in at the shop; we ship them insured, follow them through the grader, and hand them back to you in their slabs.
home.bookWithoutList: Book a drop-off without a list
home.bookWithoutListNote: Listing the cards first makes the counter quicker; without a list we write them down with you.
home.linkSent: Check your inbox: we sent a link to {email}. Same email, no password.
home.error: We could not load your submissions. Try again in a moment.

list.title: List the cards and what you would insure each for
list.body: A few minutes on this phone, no account needed. The declared value picks the level and the cover; it never sways the grade.

handIn.title: Book a drop-off and hand them in
handIn.body: About {minutes} minutes at the counter: we check each card against your list, you sign on our iPad, and you pay the fee at the till.

leave.title: They leave with the week’s batch
leave.body: Insured both ways. We read the grader’s stages most days and email you the moment the grades post.

collect.title: Collect in person with the pickup code
collect.body: Any opening hour, no booking. Someone you name can collect for you. Slabs are never shipped.

priceSheet.title: What it costs
priceSheet.lead: Example fees, a card, including the grader’s fee and insured shipping both ways. Express and Super Express add cover at {rate} of the declared value. Paid when you hand the cards in.
priceSheet.row: Cards up to {ceiling} · back in about {weeks} weeks
priceSheet.graders: Each grader has its own sheet; the others are on their tabs when you pick the service.
priceSheet.aboveTop: A card worth more than {ceiling}? Ask at the counter or WhatsApp us first, so the right level is ready.
priceSheet.bulkLine: Twenty cards or more take the Bulk level and a longer drop-off, booked the same way.

submissions.title: Your submissions
submissions.empty: Nothing here yet. Start a submission and it shows up here.
submissions.emptySignedOut: Sign in to see yours here

home.lostLink: Every submission is also reachable from its emailed link, with no account. Lost the link? Sign in with the same email; there is no password.

plan.title: List the cards you are bringing
plan.lead: Name and set, and what you would insure each one for. The declared value picks the service level and the cover; it never sways the grade.

aboutYou.title: About you
aboutYou.name: Name
aboutYou.signedInLine: Filled from your account when you are signed in; change them for this submission here.
aboutYou.emailLine: The moment you leave, we email the link to this submission to this address, so you can finish on any device — no account needed.

card.keptAsTyped: Kept as you typed it · no reference
card.referenceNote: {grader} asks for the value at the grade you expect. A reference, not a valuation.
card.minimumGrade: Only encapsulate at {grade} or above · the fee applies either way
card.noValue: Tell us the declared value before you continue.
card.aboveCeiling: {name} is worth more than this level takes. It goes in a second submission at a higher level, on the same drop-off.
card.referenceUnavailable: We could not reach the catalogue, so this card keeps the name you typed. The value is still needed.

plan.pasteNote: Paste one card a line, name, set, number and value, for many cards at once. A card the catalogue cannot match keeps the name you typed and shows no reference.
plan.capNotice: All the cards go to one grader at one level. Up to {standard} cards from Value to Super Express; up to {bulk} at Bulk. A card that needs a different level goes in a second submission, and both come to the same drop-off.
plan.overTwenty: More than {standard} cards, so Bulk is the only level open at the next step.
plan.overCap: {bulk} cards is the most one submission takes. The rest go in a second submission, another day.
plan.finishLaterEmail: Tell us where to email the link, and we keep the list.

pasteSheet.title: Paste a list
pasteSheet.lead: One card a line: name, set and number, then the value you would insure it for. We match each line against the catalogue; a line we cannot match keeps the name you typed and shows no reference. A line naming a card already on your list is skipped.
pasteSheet.matched: {count} matched in the catalogue — the ungraded, {lower} and {upper} references show beside each on the list.
pasteSheet.keptAsTyped: {count} kept as typed — {names}: no reference beside them; the name you typed stands.
pasteSheet.withoutValue: {count} without a value — {names}: the list asks for it before you continue.
pasteSheet.aboveCeiling: {count} above the Bulk ceiling — {names} goes in a second submission at a higher level, on the same drop-off; the next step names it while it stays on this list.
pasteSheet.bulkNotice: {count} cards: more than {standard}, so Bulk is the only level open at the next step. At {grader} that is {fee} a card, cards up to {ceiling}, about {weeks} weeks and the longer drop-off; up to {bulk} cards a submission.

service.title: Pick the grader and the level
service.lead: The level is the most any one card is worth, and how fast it comes back.

level.open: Value up to {ceiling} a card · {fee} a card
level.closedByCount: Not available: Bulk starts at {minimum} cards and you have {count}.
level.bulkOnly: More than {standard} cards, so Bulk is the only level open.
level.allClosed: One card is worth more than the top level takes. Ask at the counter or WhatsApp us first, so the right level is ready.

estimate.title: Your estimate
estimate.coverPerCard: Cover {rate} of the declared value · {amount} a card
estimate.paidAtCounter: Paid at the counter once the cards are checked.
estimate.includes: Includes the grader’s fee and insured shipping both ways.

service.upchargeNotice: If a card comes back worth more than the level allows, the grader moves it up a level and we pass on the difference. You are told the amount before you collect, never at the counter.

review.title: Check it, then book the drop-off
review.backIn: Back in about {weeks} weeks from the day your cards leave
review.schedule: The cards, as you listed them

warning.line: {card}: if it grades {grade} it is worth about {value}, above {level}’s {ceiling}, so the grader moves it to {nextLevel} and {difference} more is due at the counter before you collect.
warning.nowLine: {nextLevel} for this card would cost {higherFee} now; {level} costs {fee}, plus {difference} only if it grades {grade}.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know before you book

fee.title: A fee is charged even when a card comes back ungraded
fee.body: The grader does the work either way. A card it will not take is refused at our counter instead, and never charged.

upcharge.title: A card can move up a level
upcharge.body: If it comes back worth more than the level allows. We tell you the difference before you collect.

estimate.title: The return date is an estimate
estimate.body: The grader grades on its own clock. We show its stages as they happen and email you the moment the grades are in.

keep.title: You keep the cards until you hand them in
keep.body: Nothing is paid or signed before our staff have checked each card with you.

collect.title: We do not ship slabs back
collect.body: You collect in person, or someone you name on the submission page collects for you.

review.consent: I have read the personal information collection statement.
review.expired: This list has expired. Prices and references move, so start again from the price sheet.

dropoff.title: Book the drop-off
dropoff.lead: Bring the {count} cards. The visit takes about {minutes} minutes; nothing is paid until each card is checked and you have signed.
dropoff.bulkLead: Bring the {count} cards. Twenty or more books the longer Bulk drop-off, about {minutes} minutes; nothing is paid until each card is checked and you have signed.
dropoff.nothingFree: Nothing is free on this day any more.
dropoff.error: We could not read the diary. Try again in a moment.

shop.durations: about {minutes} minutes for up to {standard} cards; {standard} or more books the longer Bulk drop-off, about {bulkMinutes} minutes
shop.moreShops: More shops appear here as they open.
shop.joinsExisting: Already have a drop-off booked? A second submission joins it: one visit, both lists.

batchLine.before: Hand in by {cutOff} and your cards leave with the batch on {shipDay}.
batchLine.after: After that, the next batch closes {cutOff} and leaves {shipDay}.
batchLine.estimateFrom: The estimate runs from the day the batch leaves.

dropoff.moveOrCancel: Move or cancel the visit any time before it starts. Miss it and we close the visit, not your list: book another drop-off from the submission page.
dropoff.joined: This submission joins the drop-off you already have on {day}, {time}. One visit, both lists.
dropoff.resized: Both lists together pass {standard} cards, so the visit takes the longer Bulk drop-off. We moved it once in the diary; the day and time stand.

booked.title: Your drop-off is booked
booked.emailLine: A confirmation is on its way by email, with a calendar file and this submission’s link. We remind you the day before.

cards.title: Bring the {count} cards, each in a sleeve
cards.body: Penny sleeves are fine. No toploaders taped shut, and nothing you want back: the grader keeps the sleeve.

list.title: Have this list handy
list.body: Staff check each card against it. You can change the list until the cards are checked in.

pay.title: Sign on our iPad, then pay {amount} at the counter
pay.body: Once every card is checked with you and photographed. By card, cash or FPS at the till.

leave.title: Your cards leave on {shipDay}
leave.body: Handed in by {cutOff}, they go with that week’s batch. Estimated back at the shop by {estimate}.

booked.vaultLine: Want to open a vault case on the same visit — for a card you are not grading, or one coming back? Verify your identity on your phone first; grading itself needs no ID.

submission.error: We could not load this submission. Try again in a moment.
submission.notFound: We could not find that submission. Check the link we emailed you.
submission.cancelled: Cancelled. The cards never left you, and nothing was paid.
submission.expired: Expired. Nothing was paid and nothing is owed.

status.returned: Back at the shop, being checked

lead.planned: Not handed in yet. Book the drop-off and bring the cards; nothing is paid until they are checked in.
lead.booked: Bring the {count} cards on {when}. Staff check each card against your list with you, you sign the submission agreement, and you pay {amount} at the counter. Change the list any time until then.
lead.checked_in: Your cards are sealed in our intake bag and leave for {grader} with the batch that closes {cutOff} and ships {shipDay}. We email you when they are on their way, and the moment the grades are in.
lead.sent: With {grader} since {when} — being graded. Nothing to do: we read the grader’s status most days and email you the moment the grades are in.
lead.graded: {grader} posted the grades on {when} and shipped the cards back on {shippedOn}. We email you again once they are checked in at the shop, by about {estimate}.
lead.returned: The cards are back at the shop and we are checking them against {grader}’s manifest. Nothing to do; we email you the moment they are ready.
lead.ready: {items}, checked against {grader}’s manifest on {when}. Come any time we are open and show the code below.
lead.collected: You collected {items} on {when} and settled {amount}. This page keeps the record: grades, certs, slab photographs and every receipt.
lead.cancelled: This submission was cancelled. The cards never left you, and nothing was paid.
lead.expired: This list expired unbooked. Nothing was paid and nothing is owed.

exception.refused: A card the grader would not take: altered, trimmed, a reprint, or declared above the level. It stays in your hands with the reason, and its fee is never charged. The list and the estimate drop to the cards that go on.
exception.missedDropoff: The visit closes; your list and estimate stay exactly as they were. Book another drop-off from the submission page.
exception.withdrawn: Changed your mind after hand-in? Until the batch closes we pull the card from the intake bag. Message us, then collect it at the counter against a receipt: its fee comes back at the till.
exception.ungraded: The grader sent the card back raw with its note. The fee still applies, as the grader’s terms say; you were told this before you booked.
exception.minimumNotMet: You asked for a minimum grade and it graded below it, so it comes back raw rather than in a slab you did not want. The fee still applies.
exception.movedUp: The card came back worth more than the level allows, so the grader charged the next level. The difference is due at the counter before collection — told the day the grades post, never a surprise.
exception.gradeNotAccepted: The grade is the grader’s decision, not ours. A review is a new submission at the grader’s review fee; ask at the counter.
exception.runningLate: The grader is past the estimate. The page says so with the grader’s stage, and we email the new date the day we set it. Nothing changes at the counter.
exception.held: The grader kept one card for a further look and shipped the rest. The others are ready to collect now; the receipt names the card still out, and a second hand-back closes the submission.
exception.notReturned: A card that does not come back, or comes back damaged, is settled at its declared value with its fee refunded, within {days} days. We claim from the grader or the courier ourselves; you do not wait for that.
exception.refunds: A refund goes back the way it was paid, at the till: a refused line, a withdrawn card, a card not returned. Nothing is refunded on an ungraded card, and the grader’s fee never comes back once the batch has left.
exception.notCollected: Reminders while the cards wait, then a storage fee, then written notice. After the notice the cards may be sold under the Disposal of Uncollected Goods Ordinance (Cap. 456), the proceeds less fees held for you.

visit.missed: The visit closed. Your list and estimate stay exactly as they were.

cancel.title: Cancel this submission
cancel.line: Cancels the drop-off with it. The cards never left you, and nothing was paid.
cancel.dialogBody: The drop-off on {when} is cancelled with it. The cards never left you, and nothing was paid.

withdraw.title: Changed your mind?
withdraw.body: Until the batch closes on {cutOff} we can pull a card. Message us, then collect it at the counter: its fee comes back at the till, and the estimate drops to the cards that go on.
withdraw.closed: The batch has closed and the cards are on their way. Nothing can be pulled now.

grader.stages: {grader}’s stages, in its words. A stage can take days; the estimate is what we promise, the stages are what the grader reports.
grader.nextStage: We email you the moment the grades post.
grader.runningLate: Past {estimate} this reads Running late, the new date shows here with the grader’s stage, and we email it the day we set it. Nothing changes at the counter.

grades.headline: Grades are in: {summary}

settle.title: One thing to settle before you collect
settle.body: {card} came back worth about {value}, above the {level} level’s {ceiling}, so {grader} moved it to {nextLevel}. The difference is {amount}.
settle.nothingToDo: Card, cash or FPS at the till, when you collect. Nothing to do now.

ungraded.title: About the ungraded card
ungraded.body: {card} comes back raw, in a sleeve with the grader’s note: {code}, {note}. The grader charges its fee whether or not it encapsulates, so nothing is refunded for it.

grades.aboutGrades: A grade is the grader’s decision, not ours. If you want a second look, a review is a new submission at the grader’s review fee; ask at the counter when you collect.

cards.title: The cards · {count}
cards.declaredValues: Declared values · change them until the cards are checked in
cards.intakeIdsOnly: Intake ids, printed on the sleeves
cards.photographPair: Front and back, photographed at the counter with you
cards.reversalLine: The card turned up, so the settlement was reversed and the card is back on this submission.

pickup.title: Pickup code · show it at the counter

bring.label: Bring
bring.aboveThreshold: an ID matching the name: your declared total is above {threshold}. Nothing is kept
bring.named: an ID matching the name, yours or {name}’s: your declared total is above {threshold}. Nothing is kept
bring.none: nothing — the code and your name release the cards

named.title: Someone else collecting?
named.lead: Name them here and they collect with the code; the pickup card above says whether to bring an ID. With nobody named, only you can.
named.placeholder: Full name, as on their ID
named.line: They collect with the pickup code, and the ID the pickup card asks for; the hand-back receipt names them. One person at a time.
named.refused: The cards have already been collected, so nobody else can be named.

vaultIt.title: Keep it with us instead?
vaultIt.body: {card} can go straight into the vault from the counter: no second visit, and storage is free. A loan against it is an offer the vault makes after valuing it. The other cards come home with you. Say so at the counter: the identity check and the custody agreement take about {minutes} minutes there.

money.title: Money
money.paidAtCounter: At the counter, once the cards are checked
money.due: Due at the counter before collection
money.waived: The upcharge was waived. Nothing is due.
money.storageLine: {rate} a card a month since {day} · accruing
money.includesLine: the grader’s fee and insured shipping both ways
money.footnote: A fee is charged even when a card comes back ungraded. A card refused at our counter is never charged.

ladder.title: If you do not collect
ladder.reminders: We remind you on {first} and {second}. Reminders never cost anything.
ladder.storage: From {day}, a storage fee of {rate} a card a month. It accrues here and is due before collection.
ladder.afterNotice: After it, nothing further follows: the cards stay yours, and a slab can go into a vault case.
ladder.closing: We do not ship slabs back. Rather keep them here on purpose? Vault it, above.

collected.lead: This page keeps the record: grades, certs, slab photographs and every receipt.

whatNext.title: What next
whatNext.vault: Vault it — free storage in the shop, or a loan against it after a valuation.
whatNext.auction: Sell it at auction — the grade and the cert carry straight into the listing.
whatNext.yourData: Your data — this record and the photographs are kept for seven years, as our retention table says. Ask for erasure by signing in with this email.

events.dropoff_detached: Drop-off closed by the submission that owned it
events.dropoff_joined: Joined the drop-off another submission booked
events.card_withdrawn: Card withdrawn before the batch closed
events.card_minimum_not_met: Card below its minimum grade, returned raw
events.payout_reversed: Payout reversed: the card turned up
events.handed_back: Handed back {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}

TOKEN_INVALID.title: This signing link does not open anything
TOKEN_INVALID.message: Ask staff to prepare it again.

TOKEN_EXPIRED.title: This signing link has expired
TOKEN_EXPIRED.message: Signing links last a short while for your safety; ask staff for a new one.

TOKEN_CONSUMED.title: This signing link has already been used
TOKEN_CONSUMED.message: If you signed with it, your copy is at the counter and on your submission page; if not, ask staff for a new link.

TOKEN_CONFLICT.title: This link was opened on another device
TOKEN_CONFLICT.message: A signing link stays on the device it was first opened on; ask staff for a new link for this device.

PACKET_VOIDED.title: These documents were withdrawn
PACKET_VOIDED.message: A newer set replaced them; ask staff for the link to the current documents.

PACKET_EXPIRED.title: These documents have expired
PACKET_EXPIRED.message: They were prepared too long ago to sign now. Ask for them to be prepared again.

DOCUMENT_UNKNOWN.title: That document is not part of this signing
DOCUMENT_UNKNOWN.message: Reload the page to see the documents you were asked to sign.

DOCUMENT_ALREADY_SIGNED.title: You have already signed that one
DOCUMENT_ALREADY_SIGNED.message: Reload the page to carry on with whatever is still left to sign.

PAGES_NOT_VIEWED.title: Read the whole document before signing
PAGES_NOT_VIEWED.message: Scroll to the end of every page.

PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE.title: That page is not in this document
PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE.message: Reload the page and read the document through again.

CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: Please confirm you agree first
CONSENT_REQUIRED.message: Tick the box confirming you have read the document and agree to sign it.

ESIGN_CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: Please agree to sign electronically first
ESIGN_CONSENT_REQUIRED.message: Read the notice about signing electronically and agree to it before signing anything.

KYC_REQUIRED.title: Your identity check is not recorded yet
KYC_REQUIRED.message: The member of staff with you needs to record your ID check before you sign.

IDENTITY_NAME_MISMATCH.title: That is not the name on your ID
IDENTITY_NAME_MISMATCH.message: Type your name exactly as it appears on the ID the member of staff with you checked. If the ID is in another name, they need to record the check again.

SIGNER_OUT_OF_ORDER.title: The counter is not ready for this document yet
SIGNER_OUT_OF_ORDER.message: The member of staff with you can say what is outstanding.

SIGNER_ALREADY_SIGNED.title: You have already signed everything
SIGNER_ALREADY_SIGNED.message: Nothing further is needed from you. You can close this page.

SIGNER_NAME_MISMATCH.title: That is not the name this submission was booked under
SIGNER_NAME_MISMATCH.message: Type it as it was given at booking.

POSTAL_ADDRESS_REQUIRED.title: Your postal address is needed before you sign
POSTAL_ADDRESS_REQUIRED.message: It is used only for the written notice.

SIGNATURE_INVALID.title: That signature could not be read
SIGNATURE_INVALID.message: Clear the signature box and sign again.

SOURCE_MISSING.title: The document could not be loaded
SOURCE_MISSING.message: Ask the member of staff with you to prepare it again.

SOURCE_TAMPERED.title: The document does not match what was prepared
SOURCE_TAMPERED.message: Do not sign. Ask the member of staff with you to prepare it again.

FONT_MISSING.title: The document cannot be drawn right now
FONT_MISSING.message: Nothing has been signed. Ask the member of staff with you; the shop has to restore its document font first.

CONFLICT.title: This signing was finished elsewhere
CONFLICT.message: Another device completed or withdrew it while this page was open.

yourName.label: Your name
yourName.hintNamed: As named on the submission page

postalAddress.label: Postal address
postalAddress.hint: Used only for the written notice, if the cards are left uncollected.

ceremony.afterAgreement: Signed. Pay the fee at the till and staff take the cards in.
ceremony.afterReceipt: Signed. The cards are yours; the receipt is on your submission page and in your inbox.

sealed.emailed: A copy is on its way to your inbox, and it stays on your submission page.

ceremony.declined: Nothing was signed and nothing was paid. The member of staff with you can help with what happens next.

whatsapp.confirmDropoff: Hi {name}, confirming your grading drop-off on {when} at {shop}. Bring the {count} cards, each in a sleeve. Your submission: {link}
whatsapp.onTheirWay: Hi {name}, your {count} cards left us today for {grader}, insured. Estimated back at the shop by {estimate}. Your submission: {link}
whatsapp.runningLate: Hi {name}, {grader} is past the estimate we gave you on submission {id}. The new date is {estimate}; nothing changes at the counter. Your submission: {link}
whatsapp.gradesIn: Hi {name}, the grades are in for submission {id}. {summary}. We will message you again when the cards are ready to collect: {link}
whatsapp.readyToCollect: Hi {name}, your cards are ready to collect at {shop}. Pickup code {code}, {toSettle} to settle at the counter. Open {hours}. Your submission: {link}
whatsapp.notReturned: Hi {name}, one card from submission {id} did not come back from {grader}. We settle it at its declared value and refund its fee. Your submission: {link}
whatsapp.stillHere: Hi {name}, your graded cards have been ready at {shop} since {since}. Pickup code {code}. Nothing extra is due for the reminder. Your submission: {link}

error.diaryUnavailable: We could not read the diary, so the letter has nothing to print. Try again in a moment.
